description: Original MauForma paired sidebar + main-content palette examples (never official brand colors and never automatically approved). Keep all selected options pending until a real user confirms or explicitly delegates.

references.title: Linear — design refresh and custom themes
references.observed: Sidebar hierarchy and density are deliberately tuned; theme generation considers base hue, accent and contrast, with light and dark modes
references.applies: Long-running workspaces, project management and high-frequency navigation
references.caveat: Do not assume example palette values replicate Linear production colors

references.title: Linear — calmer navigation sidebar
references.observed: Navigation should recede so main content receives attention; the sidebar is made visually quieter
references.caveat: This is design reasoning, not proof that dark nav is always preferable

references.title: IBM Carbon — UI shell left panel
references.observed: Default, hover, active, focus and text/icon colors are explicitly tokenized; shell uses theme context
references.applies: Enterprise dashboards and consistent component states
references.caveat: IBM theme tokens are not mandatory for other products

references.title: GitHub Primer — page layout and color usage
references.observed: Navigation pane and content have separate spatial responsibilities; focus on content and consistent responsive page regions
references.applies: Developer tools, repositories and workspace side panes
references.caveat: Do not claim that demo colors here are sampled from GitHub's UI

references.title: GitHub Primer — color usage
references.observed: Color design integrates light/dark schemes with shared component semantics rather than arbitrary local selection
references.caveat: Use as a consistency reference, not a license to copy interface branding

references.title: shadcn/ui — sidebar theming
references.observed: Sidebar roles include sidebar background, foreground, primary, accent, border and ring; sidebar can differ from page but belongs in the theme
references.applies: Vue/React implementations using tokens, side-nav states and shared primitives
references.caveat: shadcn sample tokens are not a branding recommendation

references.title: Atlassian Design — design tokens
references.observed: Design tokens are a single source of truth; selected states may use neutral rather than blue colors
references.applies: Cross-page products with many components and theme switching
references.caveat: Feature-flagged selected-state behavior must not be stated as a universal Atlassian UI rule

palettes.name: 石墨侧栏 × 明亮内容区
palettes.character: 工具感，侧边栏安静，主内容清晰
palettes.tradeoff: 暗亮交界较明显，需处理顶部栏、品牌按钮及分隔边界；不适合所有纯浅色品牌

palettes.name: 浅灰侧栏 × 白色内容区
palettes.character: 整页统一、层次细腻，适合长时间查看数据
palettes.tradeoff: 少了暗色侧边栏的强边界，必须依靠精确的选中态与对比度

palettes.name: 暖纸白 × 沙岩侧栏
palettes.character: 温暖、稳重，不靠冷蓝色营造专业感
palettes.tradeoff: 工程分析的冷静气质可能被弱化，需要从品牌性格验证是否合适

palettes.name: 墨黑工作台 × 低饱和青绿
palettes.character: 侧栏退后，适合需要长时间聚焦数据和代码的暗色工作台
palettes.tradeoff: 需要专门考虑数据序列色、夜间亮度、图表对比和暗色阴影

palettes.name: 蓝色品牌保留 × 受控中性表面
palettes.character: 品牌明确偏好蓝色时保留蓝，避免主内容和导航处处泛蓝
palettes.tradeoff: 只在用户明确偏好/已有品牌色时优先推荐，避免重新产生自动蓝色模板
